value.rationale: The reflected arithmetic-gap family is a natural, globally parameterized nonuniform perturbation of classical Bernstein sampling. Its exact positivity region consists of only two isolated points, one of them previously unanticipated and genuinely nonuniform. A root-of-unity obstruction eliminates all irrational gaps and almost all rational ones; a precise third-harmonic mechanism finishes the sharp classification. This is a complete structural rigidity result, not merely a positive example or arbitrary finite evaluation.
